description: Defines a ScheduleDefinition + underlying asset job that materializes the configured asset keys on cron. Two modes: (1) un-partitioned — ScheduleDefinition with your cron; (2) time-partitioned — build_schedule_from_partitioned_job, cron is decomposed into minute_of_hour/hour_of_day/day_of_week/day_of_month args and combined with the partitions_def cadence (Dagster forbids passing a raw cron_schedule for time-partitioned jobs). Cron validated against partitions_def cadence; static/dynamic partitions rejected in the partitioned path with a helpful error.

schedule_name.label: Schedule Name
schedule_name.description: Unique schedule name shown in the UI.

cron_expression.label: Cron Expression
cron_expression.description: Cron expression (5 fields: m h dom mon dow). E.g. '0 9 * * *' = daily 09:00. REQUIRED when no partition fields are set; OPTIONAL when partitioned (cadence is inferred from the partitions_def; when supplied, cron is decomposed into offset args and validated against cadence).

asset_keys.label: Asset Keys
asset_keys.description: Slash-separated asset keys to materialize on each tick.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the underlying job (defaults to '<schedule_name>_job').

execution_timezone.label: Execution Timezone
execution_timezone.description: IANA timezone for cron evaluation, e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles'. Applied in the un-partitioned path; in the partitioned path Dagster uses the partitions_def's timezone (this field is silently ignored).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags applied to runs created by this schedule.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned. Only time-based types work with the partitioned-job path.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start in ISO format (e.g. '2024-01-01' or '2024-01-01-00:00' for hourly). Required for time-based types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name
dynamic_partition_name.description: Name for DynamicPartitionsDefinition (when partition_type='dynamic'). Rejected in the partitioned-schedule path.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: CronSchedule
